title: aee-conformance: conformance vectors and a reference verifier for the adversarial-execution-evidence predicate
description:
A recomputable execution attestation toolkit for the in-toto adversarial execution evidence predicate.

The predicate's model is execute-and-attest rather than match-and-assert: a consumer recomputes the outcome from the bytes the statement carries, instead of trusting a verdict the producer asserted about itself. This repository is a second, independently usable implementation of that contract, so that any producer of the predicate type can self-certify and any consumer can reject a lying emitter.

This deposit covers suite revision 19: 226 vectors, of which 52 accept, 172 reject and 2 are indeterminate, exercised by rails in two languages. The corpus is versioned and immutable per revision. A published revision is never mutated in place; a normative change to the predicate, or an addition to the corpus, bumps the revision and regenerates every vector byte-identically from its generators, because the vendored specification's digest is itself a corpus input.

The intended use is citation by a conformance requirement. A requirement that names this suite, or any other suite demonstrated to exercise the same conditions, is checkable by a party who trusts neither the producer nor the implementer.
